title: Moje nie zostaje
sunoPrompt: Fast jagged punk rock, 164 BPM, dry crashing live drums, serrated guitar riffs, elastic bass and direct rough sung vocals. Short insistent repeated chorus, sparse tight verses, charged small-venue recording. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
